llm.guidance: This skill appears low-risk and coherent: it only prints offline reference text and does not require API keys, network access, or other credentials. If you plan to install it, you can proceed with confidence but as a routine precaution: (1) verify the skill source (the GitHub repo and bytesagain.com) if provenance matters, (2) review any future updates for added network calls or environment access, and (3) ensure your agent's runtime policy restricts arbitrary execution if you do not want bundled scripts to run on your system. Note: there is a minor non-security issue in the help text (a quoted heredoc prevents $VERSION from expanding), but this is a bug, not a security concern.
